review_scope: Independent source-only regression acceptance review focused on note switch, unmount, append, and in-flight save behavior.

current_source_assessment.severity: S2 is warranted: a successfully acknowledged save can be an older snapshot while newer user-authored content is discarded; the content may be unrecoverable after reload.
current_source_assessment.priority: P1 is warranted for data-loss remediation before shipping the autosave correction.
current_source_assessment.mechanism: persist returns immediately whenever inflightRef is true. Debounced timer and onAppend both call persist without retaining a queued snapshot. Component cleanup also calls persist fire-and-forget. inflightRef is shared by the component as noteId changes; the reset effect clears the timer and draft but does not reset or wait for the in-flight write.

acceptance_cases.title: Edits made during a pending save reach storage
acceptance_cases.setup: Open an existing member note. Use a controllable updateNote response so the first write remains pending.
steps: Change content to snapshot A and wait for the 600 ms debounce to invoke the first update.
While the first request is pending, change content to snapshot B and wait for the second debounce to expire.
Resolve the first write successfully, wait for all autosave work to settle, then refetch the note from the data source.
assertions: The stored content equals snapshot B, not snapshot A.
The save indicator only reports Saved after snapshot B has succeeded.
No second edit disappears after reload.

acceptance_cases.title: Switching notes while a save is pending does not lose or cross-write either note
acceptance_cases.setup: Open note A and note B with distinct initial content; hold A's update request pending.
steps: Edit A and allow its write to start.
Navigate Back, open B, wait for B to hydrate, edit B, and let B's debounce expire before releasing A's request.
Resolve A, wait for saves to settle, then refetch both notes.
assertions: A contains its latest A draft.
B contains its latest B draft.
No B content is written to A and no A completion changes B's save status to Saved.
acceptance_cases.source_risk: NoteEditor is reused with a changing noteId; the shared inflightRef is not reset or keyed by note ID. Its cleanup can launch the old note's pending snapshot before the new note reset effect.

acceptance_cases.title: Appending page content during a pending autosave is persisted
acceptance_cases.setup: Open a note and hold an ordinary update request pending.
steps: Edit the body and allow its debounced write to start.
Use Append from page to append distinctive content before the pending write resolves.
Resolve the pending write, wait for autosave work to settle, and refetch the note.
assertions: Stored content includes the pre-existing text and appended block in order.
The append action does not get lost when persist encounters another in-flight request.
acceptance_cases.source_risk: onAppend calls persist directly; the current in-flight early return drops this snapshot and does not schedule a trailing save.

acceptance_cases.title: Leaving the editor with a pending latest draft does not discard it
acceptance_cases.setup: Open a note and use a controllable update response.
steps: Change to snapshot B while A remains pending and wait until B's debounce fires.
Immediately navigate Back or switch to another tab, resolve A, and later reopen/refetch the original note.
assertions: The latest snapshot B is eventually stored despite editor unmount.
A pending save is not treated as completion of a newer unsaved draft.
acceptance_cases.source_risk: Unmount cleanup clears the timer and invokes persist(draftRef.current), but persist returns immediately while A is in flight; the component then unmounts without retaining B elsewhere.

fix_acceptance_boundary: Queue or serialize writes so the newest draft is retained while a request is pending.
Associate queued drafts and in-flight saves with the note ID they belong to; a note switch must not cross-write or let an old completion mark the new note saved.
Use one persistence path for debounce, append, note-switch cleanup, and unmount cleanup so none can bypass the queue.
Keep failure visible and retryable; do not mark a newer draft saved when only an older snapshot succeeded.
limits: This is an independent source-path review and proposed concrete regression acceptance, not an executed regression test or native verification.
No product files were edited and no build, tests, or browser run was performed.
